sections.text_helper: Section 31.6.32 "TIM multilevel protection register 2 (TIM_MPR2)" in chapter 31 (Advanced-control timers (TIM1/TIM8)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1124.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x094
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:24 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 23:16 DBK2[7:0]: Delayed 2 Break duration
This bitfield defines the duration of the delay in Delayed 2 Break mode.
It is partially preloaded and can be updated during timer operation (new value taken into
account after an update event), at the exception of the bits coding for tDTG selection, which
are not preloaded.
It is thus recommended to update only the least significant bits to have the expected duration
value:
• DBK2[6:0] if DBK2[7] = 0
• DBK2[5:0] if DBK2[7:6] = 10
• DBK2[4:0] if DBK2[7:5] = 110 or 111
DBK2[7:5]=0xx => Delay2=DBK2[7:0]xtDTG with tDTG=tDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=10x => Delay2=(64+DBK2[5:0])xtDTG with tDTG=2xtDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=110 => Delay2=(32+DBK2[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=8xtDTS.
DBK2[7:5]=111 => Delay2=(32+DBK2[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=16xtDTS.
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 2 or 3 has been programmed (LOCK
bits in TIM_BDTR register).
Bits 15:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 DBK1[7:0]: Delayed 1 Break duration
This bitfield defines the duration of the delay in Delayed 1 Break mode.
It is partially preloaded and can be updated during timer operation (new value taken into
account after an update event), at the exception of the bits coding for tDTG selection, which
are not preloaded.
It is thus recommended to update only the least significant bits to have the expected duration
value:
• DBK1[6:0] if DBK1[7] = 0
• DBK1[5:0] if DBK1[7:6] = 10
• DBK1[4:0] if DBK1[7:5] = 110 or 111
DBK1[7:5]=0xx => Delay1=DBK1[7:0]xtDTG with tDTG=tDTS.
DBK1[7:5]=10x => Delay1=(64+DBK1[5:0])xtDTG with tDTG=2xtDTS.
DBK1[7:5]=110 => Delay1=(32+DBK1[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=8xtDTS.
DBK1[7:5]=111 => Delay1=(32+DBK1[4:0])xtDTG with tDTG=16xtDTS.
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 2 or 3 has been programmed (LOCK
bits in TIM_BDTR register).
